en.title: OpenAI Codex Outage Sparks Developer Discussion
en.hook: Service disruption in OpenAI Codex highlights developer reliance on AI coding tools.
key_takeaways: Unplanned service downtime affecting OpenAI Codex API and dependent integration tools
Community discussions around the impact of AI outages on day-to-day developer productivity
Considerations for local model fallbacks and redundancy strategies for AI-assisted workflows

zh.title: OpenAI Codex 服务中断引发开发者关注
zh.hook: OpenAI Codex 服务宕机引发关于 AI 编程工具依赖性的探讨
key_takeaways: OpenAI Codex API 及相关代码辅助工具出现突发服务中断
开发者社区对 AI 辅助编程停机导致的工作流影响展开讨论
探讨降低云端 AI 依赖以及引入本地模型作为备选方案的必要性
